sample_title: RNA-seq data of pooled juvenile males from a Schistosoma mansoni population sensitive to praziquantel (lib. rep. 1)
sample_description: RNA sequence data of pooled Schistosoma mansoni juvenile males from a praziquantel sensitive population. A previous GWAS revealed a QTL associated with praziquantel resistance and we used a marker from this QTL to create a population enriched in allele associated with praziquantel resistance (ES: enriched sensitive). We compared gene expression of this population to others from a different stage or sex. The same RNA was used to performed the 3 library replicates.
experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 4000 sequencing: RNA-seq of Schistosoma mansoni: pool of juvenile males with enriched sensitive allele to praziquantel
